approach: TDD RED-first: 11 integration tests written and observed failing (ModuleNotFoundError: backend.approvals) before any production code
production_code: backend/approvals/commands.py — CommandRegistry; fail-closed rule (fast lane requires idempotent=True, raised at registration); default_registry: pause_intake / resume_intake / retry_job

backend/approvals/machine.py — ApprovalStateMachine: transactional compare-and-set transitions, fast lane (sync dispatch -> resolved/failed), slow lane (deterministic job-cmd-{approval_id} on the lease queue, approval_id on Job), on_job_terminal completion hook, commit-first emit-after (SSE + Grafana annotation), propose_approval single creation path
backend/jobs/queue.py — requeue(): terminal-only (failed/throttled/needs_human), attempts reset, transactional
backend/stations/spend/control.py — pause/resume routed through transactional_update (H-0 pre-mortem concurrency fix: last-committed write always wins)
backend/stations/spend/act.py — approvals created only via propose_approval (single-writer); auto-resume approval now carries command resume_intake (fixes the G2 no-op-approve bug)
backend/api/spine.py — decide_approval delegates to the state machine (400/404/409 contract order preserved); single-writer rule enforced
backend/api/app.py — passes settings into spine routes (real MCP annotator)

covers: fast command without idempotent rejected at registration (fail-closed)
fast approve dispatches synchronously, resolves, emits one SSE event
fast handler failure -> failed (never stuck in acting)
slow command -> deterministic job-cmd-{approval_id} with approval_id on the Job
double dispatch -> 409-equivalent conflict, handler not re-run (exactly-once)
retry command requeues only terminal jobs
pause/resume concurrency stress: 25 rounds of racing threads, last-committed write always wins (real Firestore transactions)
single-writer grep tripwire: no module outside the machine writes approval status
completion hook resolves approval exactly once when job turns terminal
commandless approval resolves as a no-op on approve

defects_caught_and_fixed: single-writer tripwire caught spend/act.py writing approvals directly -> rewired through propose_approval
single-writer tripwire caught api/spine.py writing approval status inline -> decide_approval now delegates to the machine
Spend Control resume approval was a no-op on approve (G2 bug) -> throttle_station attaches resume_intake command
pause/resume race (H-0 pre-mortem finding) -> transactional compare-and-set via FirestoreStore.transactional_update
decision API contract: input validation (400) must beat resource lookup (404); commandless approvals resolve as no-op rather than erroring
notes: Real Firestore (dev project), per-run collections it-approvals-*/it-jobs-*. Sweeper and worker hook wiring land in tranche 2 (same design doc).

production_code: backend/jobs/worker.py — on_terminal completion hook threaded through _persist/_finish_claimed/worker_loop/process_* with hook isolation (hook failure never alters the job's terminal write)
backend/approvals/machine.py — redrive_fast (crashed fast action, fail-closed idempotent premise), fail_stale (15-min needs_human_review backstop), mark_superseded (order-safety)

backend/approvals/sweeper.py — sweep_once watchdog: reconcile terminal jobs exactly-once, patience for non-terminal jobs, backstop stale acting, capped fast redrive (3), order-safety vs newer decisions on the same intake target (fail-closed when freshness can't be proven)
backend/api/app.py — machine built once in create_app, shared by spine/worker/sweeper; _run_sweeper 10s lifespan task; worker_loop gets on_terminal
backend/api/spine.py — install_spine_routes accepts the shared machine
conftest.py — shared real-Firestore fixtures (env, run_id, per-run collections)

tests.worker_hook: tests/test_worker.py — 4 new tests (hook after terminal write, hook isolation, fail path, worker_loop)
tests.sweeper: tests/test_approval_sweeper.py — 6 integration tests (reconcile exactly-once, patience, 15-min backstop never retries the job, redrive once, cap at 3, yields to newer human decision on same target)
tests.integration: tests/test_approval_executor.py — worker terminal write resolves slow approval through real queue+machine
